Jack is interested in swimming. David thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. The night snack bar is one of the best places in the city. Cows give us milk.
Both of them like bread and coffee. David likes windy days best. It takes twenty minutes to get to the night snack bar by bike. What's more, the buns are cooked by steam.
The weather was windy that day. Life is full of small surprises. David wants to be a teacher in the future. Mom is in the kitchen.
David is reading a book about English. David hopes to visit Rome one day. There are always many people at the noodle shop.
